Cortemaggiore, Emilia-Romagna - Global Leadership Retreat 2026  
  
Our Master of Leadership students spent three transformative days at Hotel La Tavola Rotonda — a restored 13th-century castle in the Italian countryside — for the centrepiece of their programme.  
  
Not a conference. Not a seminar. A fully immersive, residential experience designed to move leadership development from the academic into the deeply personal. [...] Over three days, participants were challenged, stretched, and supported to engage with one fundamental question: Who do you want to be as a leader?  
  
The setting was deliberate. Leadership does not develop in comfort — it emerges in environments that demand clarity, presence, and intention. This is where it became real.  
  
Video credit: @flashofficial\_dije
